newsitem.title: USA: Shelby Williams sees Q4 exceeding estimates.
newsitem.headline: Shelby Williams sees Q4 exceeding estimates.

text.p: Shelby Williams Inc said Friday it expects 1996 earnings per share to exceed median analyst estimates of $0.26 a share for the fourth quarter and $0.94 for the full year.
It said revenues for the quarter, excluding its divested Preview division, increased about 11 percent. The company said it will report results on January 15.
In the 1995 fourth quarter, Shelby Williams reported operating earnings of $0.21 per share. For the full year, it had operating per-share earnings of $0.76.
Chairman Paul Steinfeld in a statement cited a continued robust hotel refurbishing business as the primary driver of the strong performance.
Shelby Williams manufactures contract seating for the restaurant, lodging, healthcare and university and college markets.
